T: Watch the dates. Trust the food.

P: Serve the dates when Indy nearly eats the poisoned one in Cairo.
S: Medjool dates stuffed with goat's cheese and almond, wrapped in prosciutto, honey
Medjool dates split and stuffed with goat's cheese and a toasted almond, wrapped in prosciutto, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, drizzled with honey.
Crisp falafel made from raw chickpeas, with lemon tahini sauce
Dried chickpeas soaked overnight, blitzed raw with onion, garlic, parsley, coriander and cumin, shaped and fried at 175C until deep brown, with tahini sauce and pickles.
the idol swapped for sand, then the boulder

Golden choux puffs loaded with gruyère and cayenne, baked until hollow and crisp, served warm in a hessian sack with a smoky tomato dip. Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g plain flour and stir over the heat for 1 minute. Cool slightly, beat in 2 eggs one at a time, then 80g grated gruyère and a pinch of cayenne. Pipe 20 small rounds, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve warm with tomato chutney mixed with smoked paprika.
M: Rice, lentils and macaroni with spiced tomato sauce and crisp fried onions
Rice and brown lentils cooked separately, layered with macaroni, topped with a spiced tomato sauce, chickpeas and crisp fried onions.
Marion's bar in Nepal, the Raven

Juicy pork and coriander dumplings with ginger and spring onion, steamed until tender, with a fiery charred tomato and chilli achar. Mix 500g pork mince with 2 tsp grated ginger, 2 garlic cloves, 3 spring onions, a handful of chopped coriander, 1 tbsp soy and salt. Fill 30 round dumpling wrappers, gather and pleat closed. Steam on oiled baking paper for 10 minutes. Char 3 tomatoes and 2 red chillies in a dry pan, then blitz with a garlic clove, 1 tsp cumin, lemon juice and salt for the achar.
W: Semolina and coconut yoghurt cake with an almond on each square, soaked in syrup
Semolina, coconut and yoghurt cake baked at 180C for 30 minutes, soaked in lemon and rose syrup, an almond on each square.
K: Black tea simmered with milk, ginger, cardamom, cinnamon and cloves

Black tea simmered with ginger, cardamom, cinnamon and cloves in milk, sweetened with brown sugar and poured steaming into mugs. Simmer 500ml water with a sliced 4cm piece of ginger, 6 crushed cardamom pods, a cinnamon stick and 4 cloves for 5 minutes. Add 4 black tea bags and 500ml milk and simmer 3 minutes more. Stir in 3 tbsp brown sugar, strain into four mugs and serve hot.

steps.text: Split the dates and stuff each with goat's cheese and an almond.
Cut the eggplant into strips, wrap one around each date and dust with smoked paprika.
Bake at 200C for 8 minutes and drizzle with honey.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix up to 1 day ahead, soak chickpeas overnight

steps.text: Soak the chickpeas in cold water overnight, then drain well.
Blitz the raw chickpeas with the onion, garlic, parsley, coriander, cumin and salt.
Shape into balls and flatten slightly.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 175C until deep brown.
Thin the tahini with lemon juice and water for the sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Cook the lentils and make the tomato sauce up to 2 days ahead, chilled; cook the rice and macaroni and fry the onions on the night

steps.text: Cook the rice, lentils and macaroni separately.
Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic, cumin and chilli into a sauce.
Fry the onions in oil until crisp.
Layer rice, lentils and macaroni, then top with the sauce, chickpeas and onions.
Mix the semolina, coconut, yoghurt, half the sugar and baking powder.
Spread in a tin, score into squares and press an almond into each.
Bake at 180C for 30 minutes.
Simmer the remaining sugar with the water and lemon juice for 5 minutes, add the rosewater and pour the hot syrup over.

dishes.make_ahead: Simmer the spiced water up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; reheat, then add the tea bags and milk on the night

steps.text: Simmer the water with the ginger, cardamom, cinnamon and cloves for 5 minutes.

Stir in the sugar and strain into four mugs.

s.note: Medjool dates stuffed with goat's cheese and almond, wrapped in prosciutto, honey
s.how: Split 12 medjool dates and stuff each with goat's cheese and a toasted almond. Wrap in half a slice of prosciutto and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Drizzle with honey. These are the good dates, no monkey business.

s.note: Crisp falafel made from raw chickpeas, with lemon tahini sauce
s.how: Soak 250g dried chickpeas overnight. Blitz raw with an onion, 2 garlic cloves, parsley, coriander and 1 tsp cumin. Shape and fry at 175C until deep brown. Thin 4 tbsp tahini with lemon and water for sauce.

m.note: Rice, lentils and macaroni with spiced tomato sauce and crisp fried onions
m.how: Cook 200g rice, 200g brown lentils and 200g macaroni separately. Simmer a tin of tomatoes with garlic, cumin and chilli. Fry 2 sliced onions until crisp. Layer rice, lentils and macaroni, top with sauce, a tin of chickpeas and the onions.

w.note: Semolina and coconut yoghurt cake with an almond on each square, soaked in syrup
w.how: Mix 200g semolina, 80g coconut, 250g Greek yoghurt, 150g sugar and 1 tsp baking powder. Spread in a tin, score into squares and press an almond into each. Bake at 180C for 30 minutes and pour over hot syrup of 150g sugar, water, lemon and rosewater.

d.note: Black tea simmered with milk, ginger, cardamom, cinnamon and cloves
d.how: Simmer 500ml water with a sliced 4cm piece of ginger, 6 crushed cardamom pods, a cinnamon stick and 4 cloves for 5 minutes. Add 4 black tea bags and 500ml milk and simmer 3 minutes more. Stir in 3 tbsp brown sugar, strain into four mugs and serve hot.
